shortDescription: The Indus Rope Bar Stool brings together timeless Indian craftsmanship and contemporary international design. Crafted from solid oak and walnut wood, featuring a beautifully handwoven Danish paper cord seat, it adds natural elegance to premium interiors.
description:
Inspired by the richness of Indian heritage and modern international furniture design, the Indus Rope Bar Stool is a statement of refined craftsmanship. Made using solid oak wood and solid walnut wood, this stool showcases a beautifully detailed wooden structure paired with a handwoven Danish paper cord seat.

Its elegant proportions and natural material combination create a sophisticated balance of warmth, durability and minimalist aesthetics. The woven seat adds distinctive texture while celebrating traditional weaving techniques.

Designed for stylish kitchen counters, luxury cafes, boutique restaurants and contemporary hospitality spaces, the Indus Rope Bar Stool brings understated luxury to any setting. Each piece reflects CULTURAFT's commitment to quality materials, thoughtful design and handcrafted excellence.
